Name: Tropical Juice
Author: ZeltronCurry
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Adds a recipe for Tropical Juice to the Island Trader. Cooked with 3 mangoes, 3 bananas, 3 pineapples, 1 ginger and 1 sugar. Gives +1 boost in all skills and luck.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Have SMAPI and Content Patcher installed.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Tropical Juice; a new cooked item providing +1 buff in all skills and luck.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Biggest shoutout is to BeazNees for making the item [/size]sprite, also shoutout to Aba and Nullnnow. Thank you guys![/color]




[color=#D4D4D8]Note: If you collected all golden walnuts on the Island and spent the remaining 14 to trade for Qi gems, you can type "/recountnuts" in the chat so they are given back [/color][color=#d4d4d8]toy, allowing you to unlock the recipe. Have Fun![/color]
